findings: Subscription confirmation dispatch pattern — AlertSubscriptionObserver uses Mail::to()->queue() instead of dispatching a queued job, causing sync decision-making in the observer and inconsistent with the alert notification flow.

Alert deduplication relies on títle immutability — SendAlertNotificationJob checks only (user_id, zone_id, type_alerte, titre) for duplicates. Editing an alert's titre after creation will cause duplicate sends to the same user.

Missing alert_id column — The alert_logs migration omits the alert_id column specified in the plan, preventing reliable identification of which source alert triggered each send and preventing deduplication across alert updates.
